_comment_moos: MoOS's uupd configuration. Identical to the shipped default except for ONE
line: the Brew module is off, because MoOS does not install Homebrew.
Left enabled, uupd runs /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew update on a path
that does not exist on any MoOS machine. The module fails, and uupd ends the
whole run with 'Updates finished with errors!' — so EVERY automatic update,
on every MoOS install, reports failure while the image, Flatpaks and
distroboxes all updated perfectly. An update path that always says it failed
is an update path nobody can read: the one time something really does break,
it looks exactly like every other night.
If MoOS ever ships Homebrew, flip this back — the module is fine, the
assumption that Homebrew exists is what was wrong.
